request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the fifteenth year of the reign
Tiberius Caesar held the throne
Pontius Pilate governed Judea
Herod tetrarch in Galilee
His brother Philip held the land
Iturea and Trachonitis
Lysanias ruled over Abilene
Names remembered in the book

[Chorus]
Philip tetrarch of the region
Ruled with a gentle hand
In the days when John appeared
His territory understood

[Verse]
He built the city Caesarea
Philippi stands on the hill
During the time of Jesus
He kept his territory
The text gives us his name
His place among the rulers
A historical figure
In Luke's account we find him

[Chorus]
Philip tetrarch of the region
Ruled with a gentle hand
In the days when John appeared
His territory understood

[Outro]
Son of Herod the Great
Ruling in Iturea
A name in the record
Of those times past
